description: This script initializes and manages a SQLite database for the application, including schema setup, environment configuration, and database statistics reporting.

methods.name: None _configure_logging()

methods.description: Creates the environment file for the database visualizer pointing to the current database path.

methods.name: None _maybe_write_db_connection_txt(canonical_db_path: Path)

methods.name: None _print_db_stats(db_file: Path)
